name: SubcontractorEngagementManager
tagline: Subcontractor POs, rates, hours against the cap and compliance documents – one plug-and-play app.
description: A complete subcontractor module for consulting, accounting, legal and IT-services firms: request, onboard, run and close every external engagement with cost and bill rates, not-to-exceed hours caps with burn tracking and change requests, and insurance / NDA / contract / tax-form checks that gate activation. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Documents required to activate (insurance expiry, NDA, contract, tax form)
Hours logging blocked beyond the not-to-exceed cap
Committed, spend, remaining value and margin KPIs
Bulk hold / activate / close / assign / request documents
Kanban with drag and drop and keyboard moves
Phone layout with bottom view bar
